findings.title: [P2] Canonicalize both paths in the CLI entry check
findings.body: When launched through a symlink with `--preserve-symlinks-main` (including through `NODE_OPTIONS`), `import.meta.url` retains the alias while `process.argv[1]` is canonicalized. The comparison therefore fails and the harness exits successfully without executing anything. Reproducing `node --preserve-symlinks-main <alias> --help` returns status 0 with empty output; measurement arguments are likewise ignored. Canonicalize both sides so this configuration cannot silently skip the run.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve PATH invocation names for tool shims
findings.body: For tools implemented as name-dispatching symlinks, executing the resolved target changes which command runs. A temporary `zig` shim forwarding to the installed compiler returned `0.16.0` through normal PATH lookup, but this preflight invoked its dispatcher directly and failed before checking sources. Thus the documented requirement of Zig 0.16.0 on PATH is insufficient for supported shim installations. Preserve the discovered invocation path separately from the resolved file used for fingerprinting.

reviewResult.overallExplanation: All eight focused tests pass, and the recorded cold statistics and historical log hashes match their summaries. However, two reproduced symlink-handling defects prevent valid invocations or silently skip measurement; the full multi-repository aggregate was not rerun.
